entities.summary: Egor Vasilyevich Kliuka is a Russian volleyball player of Belarusian descent. He is part of the Russia men's national volleyball team. He competed at the 2015 European Championship. On club level, he plays for Japanese club Suntory Sunbirds Osaka.
